description:
Implement the spec in .openspec/specs/hardening-port/spec.md. Pipeline for this order is sdlc-default (software domain, the factory repo itself), selected by the run workflow.

STAGING: this order is filed and staged only. The spec and this work order record sit on the branch anvil/run-hardening-port, the issue carries no anvil label, and no run is fired. Execution starts on the owner's word, after the producing-station failure of 2026-11-15 (wo-gh-44, run 43796424330, and two consumer projects the same night) is diagnosed. Run configuration baseline, unchanged by this filing: the order is parented on factory main dc26c4f0662bc9add8bb95a9f2f70d676fd0ef41, whose anvil.yaml carries max_run_tokens 6000000, max_runtime_turns 40 and max_packet_tokens 48000, and whose anvil.json wires the checks command (python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py').

SOURCE ARTIFACTS: two owner-supplied patches committed on this branch under work-orders/artifacts/: issue-45-anvil-hardening-core.patch (verbatim; it passed the operator's full fingerprint scan as supplied) and issue-45-anvil-hardening-repo-files.patch (SANITIZED by the operator before commit: two employer references redacted and replaced with the public factory repository; the sanitized artifact re-scanned clean; the unsanitized original is never committed anywhere). Both patches were cut against a divergent base and do not apply to current main as they stand; treat them as source material and evidence for the spec requirements, never as diffs to force-apply. Where a patch and the spec's decision basis conflict, the spec wins.

BUILD, per the spec requirements R1 to R12: the classification floor, run checkpoint and resume, write authority and sealed tests, station token caps, scaffold checks, the pre-build gate, in-run loopback, outcome metrics, and the clean reviewer (reviewer-clean, station 28, on claude-fable-5-2, through the new sdlc-clean-review pipeline; sdlc-default unchanged), plus the repository files from the sanitized patch (CHANGELOG and README entries corrected per the spec, the factory anvil.json gaining .openspec/ and .anvil/ in protected_paths as the single authorized anvil.json edit, site/index.html excluded entirely). The eleven capability specs land under .openspec/specs/ with the spec's corrections applied (runtime wording to decisions 0008 and 0010, model wording to decision 0012).

RECONCILIATION (read before building; these are settled decisions, not discoveries): decision 0008 (one model family, no OpenAI route), decision 0010 (ANVIL_RUNTIME selects claude-gateway or copilot, one wrapper holds the station contract), decision 0012 (Anthropic only; opus 5.5 workhorse, fable 5.2 only for approver, supervisor and, by this order, reviewer-clean). Overlaps with staged orders wo-gh-40, wo-gh-41 and wo-gh-42 are stated in the spec; this order does not close or supersede them. Overlap with wo-gh-44 (telemetry.py, scaffold.py, operator guide): that order merged nothing and this order does not depend on its branch.

BUILDER REPORT REQUIRED LITERALS: the builder report (runs/wo-gh-45/builder.output.md) must contain each of these in full, unabbreviated: dc26c4f0662bc9add8bb95a9f2f70d676fd0ef41, hardening-port, classification-floor, Anthropic-only. It must also state the exact full factory test count from the suite run, the names of the new test files added, and every redaction or fingerprint finding made during the port (R1).

GUARDRAILS: authorized surface for this order: the files the two patches touch, as bounded by the spec (anvil/, tools/ where the patches reach, stations/reviewer-clean/, pipelines/sdlc-clean-review.json, blueprints/, docs/, .openspec/specs/ for the eleven capability specs, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, and anvil.json for the single R11 protected-paths edit only). Pipeline files under pipelines/ other than the new sdlc-clean-review.json are protected; the port must hold without editing them. Existing test files are protected except the three the core patch modifies (tests/test_anvil.py, tests/test_gates.py, tests/test_review_parsing_integrity.py), which may be modified exactly as the patch modifies them. The filed spec under .openspec/specs/hardening-port/ and the source artifacts under work-orders/artifacts/ are inputs, not build surface. Python standard library only, no new dependency. No em dash or en dash character in any produced file. No employer or organization names beyond ANVIL and arananet in any produced file; a further fingerprint found in the artifacts is redacted and reported, never committed (R1). Nothing in this order merges, publishes or deploys anything; the run stops at the owner human gate.

GitHub issue: https://github.com/arananet/anvil-factory/issues/45
title: Hardening port: classification floor, run checkpoint, write authority, station caps, sealed tests, clean review
